description: This file defines configuration classes and related structures for a plugin system within the Thunder framework, including JSON serialization, environment settings, and service metadata.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Main configuration class for the plugin, including nested environment and root configuration classes.

classes.name: Config::Environment
classes.description: Represents environment variables with key, value, and scope.

classes.name: Config::RootConfig
classes.description: Holds root-level configuration options, including mode, remote address, and environment list.

classes.name: Config::RootConfig::RootObject
classes.description: Inner class for handling root configuration JSON object.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: Utility class for logging configuration settings.

methods.name: DataPath
methods.description: Constructs data path based on base path and class name.

methods.name: PersistentPath
methods.description: Constructs persistent storage path based on base path and postfix.

methods.name: VolatilePath
methods.description: Constructs volatile storage path based on base path and postfix.

methods.name: operator Exchange::Controller::IMetadata::Data::Service
methods.description: Converts configuration to service metadata structure.

methods.name: HostType
methods.description: Determines host type based on mode setting.

methods.name: IsSameInstance
methods.description: Checks if another config instance refers to the same plugin instance.
